user_request: Freeze the last hand model when Quest palm system controls suppress app tracking. Show contextual full-hand action poses while retaining pinch input. Replace the initial hydrant with a hand-operated well lever; upgrades unlock a rotary hydrant and then one-press automatic filling.
authority: Explicit user revision supersedes the initial hydrant-first sequence and 0.2.3 tap-valve fallback. M2 safe search/reward ledger and M3 authored progression remain PROPOSED; this is an M1 interaction revision.

decisions.purchase_window: Existing shop between incidents; no active supply connection
decisions.lever: 8 cm downward travel and return to <=2 cm from upper rest; complete cycle transfers 12 units capped by tank capacity
decisions.rotary: Signed 45 degree wrist turn opens valve; reverse turn closes. Tap does not open. Rate 30 units/s.
decisions.button: Fresh nearby pinch press toggles timed flow on/off; first press fills automatically until full. Held pinch never repeats. Rate 30 units/s.
decisions.water: No water is granted by upgrade, idle time, gear changes or retry. All accepted transfer passes through existing supply authority.
decisions.progress: Station tier retained across in-process camp/sector transitions. New expedition resets it. Retry restores tier, gear ownership, tuning, tanks and coins from the same sector-entry checkpoint. Existing no-durable-save semantics remain explicit.

requirements.acceptance: After a valid frame, SDK/system-gesture or focus loss keeps the last rendered hand stationary in world space. No invented input; firing, charging and refill stop. Reacquisition shows live hand without a duplicate and requires fresh open/pinch for gameplay. Before first tracking, no hand appears at world origin.

Distinct extinguisher squeeze, gun trigger, cannon support/pump, lever wrap, valve grasp, intake carry and button point/press silhouettes. Blend into/out of poses; visual-only geometry follows grip anchors, never feeds pose back to input or moves the camera. Both hands supported.

pages.title: 0.2.5 Hand Continuity and Contextual Action Poses
pages.intro: Historical 0.2.5 candidate and scoped device confirmation. ContactGripIteration.json defines the current 0.2.6 anchored poses, natural grasp and empty outlet behavior.

blocks.text: Quest reserves its palm-facing system gesture for system controls. Existing MetaShadowPlayer.ReadHand rejects system-gesture input. Emberdeep must not treat the frozen visual as a tracked hand: retain only the last app-valid rendered pose while input is unavailable, cancel gameplay operations, then require normal rearming on return. The operating system may suspend or replace app rendering; the app cannot force visibility over a system compositor.

Keep SDK HandVisual skeleton updates and visibility ownership intact. Use transform-only render copies of the two real tracked hands, excluding distance-grab previews. Apply contextual pose animation only to display bones. On valid-to-unavailable transition, bake the last app-valid display skeleton into a reusable static mesh; hold it at the saved world pose. No per-frame mesh bake, no input from frozen hands, no object pickup or water transfer from animation events.

items: Extinguisher: palm wraps the upper grip, thumb opposes the fingers, squeeze animation follows accepted spraying.
Pistol/fan: wrapped supporting fingers with a distinct animated index trigger; cannon uses a wider support grip and separate off-hand pull-pump grip.
Well: wrapped lever grip follows the moving handle down and back. Hydrant: valve grasp follows the rotating wheel. Creek: strainer carry and pump grasp remain separate.
Button: other fingers curl while the index points/presses at the depressed button. Interaction input remains the same fresh pinch; visual pose adoption does not silently add a second selector.

blocks.text: Pose fitting is a bounded visual approximation: blend over roughly 0.1 seconds, limit wrist correction, preserve positive scale for both hands and retain explicit solid-interior clipping. It is not full finger collision or physically simulated hand wrapping. Verify actual grip fit and comfort on each headset.

Current 0.2.5 verification: 156 EditMode and 64 PlayMode tests passed with zero failures. Both Quest and PICO APKs were built and audited; Quest installation reports 0.2.5 / code 8. The user confirmed that system-menu hand hold/recovery and a complete starter well refill cycle both work on Quest 3. Rotary/button upgrades, detailed grip fit, all postures and PICO performance remain pending. Editor action images use injected samples, not hardware tracking. See Logs/EmberdeepInteractionStages/ReleaseEvidence.json and M1DeviceAcceptance.json.

pages.title: 0.2.5 Three-Stage Free Water Station
pages.intro: WS-04 overrides the previous initial-hydrant lesson. One reachable source evolves through shop upgrades; the creek remains a separate later source.

rows: Dock tool, release, pinch-grab broad lever; move down 8 cm then return within 2 cm.
12 units per full cycle, capped at capacity. First station upgrade costs 100 coins.
Dock, grip wheel and turn 45 degrees. Reverse turn or disconnect stops flow.
30 units/s while connected and app-valid; tap gives nothing. Second upgrade costs 200 coins.
Dock, fresh press at the button. Press again to stop early.
30 units/s until full, interruption or stop. Holding the same pinch never retriggers.

blocks.text: Buying upgrades is allowed only in the safe existing shop and without a connected tool. It grants no water and cannot skip levels. Preserve the selected tier during the in-memory expedition. Retry atomically restores station tier, owned tools, tuning, tanks and coins from the entry checkpoint. New Game starts a new expedition at the well. Closing the app still has no durable expedition save; M2 persistence is not implied.

Replacement art contract: keep Socket outward +Z and tool RefillPort opposing it. Lever is a neutral grip frame, LeverVisual is the moving grip under its pivot. Valve is a stable measurement frame, ValveVisual rotates around local Z. Button is a stable frame, ButtonVisual depresses local +Z by 1 cm. Keep Pump/PumpVisual and Intake/IntakeSocket/IntakeVisual for the creek. Decorative colliders never author resource transfers.

Acceptance requires both left/right complete cycles, empty/full/partial tanks, release midstroke, invalid time/pose, tracking/system-menu suppression, ownership changes, button hold/rearm, rotary partial turn, upgrades with insufficient cash and active connection, camp return, retry and New Game. Editor/synthetic evidence does not establish physical reach or PICO performance.
